about_the_game:
⚔️ About the Demo

Step into the heat of battle in Medieval Heroes: Demo Edition — a medieval hack-and-slash wave survival experience packed with fiery combat and chaotic fun.

Take control of the Fire Hero and fight through 10 intense waves of medieval enemies using explosive abilities, smart upgrades, and quick reflexes.

🔥 What’s Inside

  • Play as the Fire Hero, master of flame and fury

  • Survive 10 waves of nonstop medieval combat

  • Command 5 battle-ready pigs with unique powers

  • Choose upgrades wisely to stay alive and grow stronger

  • Burn through hordes of enemies in fast-paced hack-and-slash action

🐷 Your Pigs, Your Power

Normally, players must breed pigs to use them in battle — but in this demo, you’ll start with 5 pre-trained pigs ready to unleash destruction alongside you.

Each pig brings its own strength, turning the tide when things get tough. Use them wisely!

🔥 A Glimpse of What’s Coming

This demo gives you a taste of what’s to come in the full Medieval Heroes release:

  • Multiple heroes with unique powers

  • Pig breeding and upgrades

  • 40 escalating waves of medieval enemies

  • Epic boss battle and massive rewards

🔥 Fight. Upgrade. Survive.
Test your might in this hack-and-slash wave survival demo and prove that even one hero — with five super pigs — can stand against the medieval hordes.
